rule.description: Production code whose reachability is governed by a configuration switch that resolves, repository wide, to a permanently falsy literal can never execute under any supported configuration; the smell covers the guarded branches, every definition whose reachability depends on them (helpers, registries, constants, constructor-seeded state, imports), and the disabling switch declarations themselves.

checks.description: A production branch guarded by a permanently disabled staging switch can never execute under any supported configuration.
checks.detected_relation: production branch -> permanently disabled staging switch
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A branch whose guard every supported configuration leaves false is unreachable in every deployed state, which is dead code riding inside live request paths.

matches.symbol: AlphaVantage._call_api_on_func (entitlement preflight branch in the request wrapper, line 135)
matches.evidence: The sync request wrapper consults the client's entitlement switch before building the url; the switch resolves to False at every assignment, so the branch is unreachable for every request the client can issue.

matches.symbol: AlphaVantage._output_format (response sampling branch in the format wrapper, line 236)
matches.evidence: The sync output-formatting wrapper consults the sampling switch before shaping the payload; no supported configuration can set the switch true, so payloads can never take the sampled path.
The coroutine request wrapper mirrors the sync preflight branch behind the same permanently false switch, so the async request path carries the same unreachable stage.
The coroutine output wrapper mirrors the sync sampling branch behind the same permanently false switch, so the sampled path is unreachable for async consumers as well.
The intraday endpoint runs a premium-entitlement check guarded by the permanently false switch before returning its request contract, adding an unreachable stage to a billable endpoint.
The MACD endpoint widens the sampling window behind the sampling switch; the permanent False at the switch keeps this per-function tuning from ever engaging.
The FX daily endpoint consults the sampling switch to shrink its request scope; the guard can never be true, so the normalization never affects the issued request.
The digital-currency daily endpoint records its per-class preview window behind the sampling switch, work that never executes while the staging stays disabled.

checks.description: A tracked definition (helper method, class registry, class constant, module helper, constructor-seeded state, or import) is unreachable because every reference to it sits only on paths the permanently disabled switches remove, on paths that only exist to feed unreachable state, or nowhere at all.
checks.detected_relation: cluster definition -> permanently disabled staging pipeline
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Staged machinery grows helpers, registries, seeds, and imports; when the staging can never engage, each of those members is dead weight that occupies the client's live request and response paths even though no supported configuration executes it.

matches.evidence: The collections import exists solely to build the sampling window inside the dead preview sampler; no other module code uses it, so the import itself is part of the dormant cluster.
The class-level record of supported premium entitlements is consulted only by the unreachable entitlement preflight helper, so its own reachability ends where the disabled pipeline begins.

The default preview window size only feeds the constructor seed of the sampling state and the sampling registry's fallback; both consumers belong to the disabled pipeline, so the constant is consumed by no supported configuration.
Every client instance is initialized with sampling-window state; the only readers sit on the unreachable sampled path, so instances carry state that no supported configuration consumes.
Every client instance carries a rejected-entitlement queue; the only writer and reader sit on the unreachable preflight path, so the failure bookkeeping never records anything.
The entitlement preflight helper implements reject-and-queue semantics for unsupported entitlements, but its only call sites branch on the permanently false switch, so the helper can never run.
The payload sampler trims a series to the configured window, but its only call site branches on the sampling switch, so the sampled branch of the response path never materializes.
The class registry maps api functions to per-function window widening strategies; its only reader is the unreachable per-endpoint resolver, so the registry never influences any artifact request.
The window resolver applies the registry override for a given function; its only caller sits behind the sampling switch inside the MACD endpoint, so the resolver is part of the dormant tuning layer.
Inside the unreachable sampling branch, the MACD endpoint widens the instance's window state before the request leaves the client, a mutation that no supported configuration performs.
The module helper normalizes a request-scope parameter for the sampled regime; its only caller branches on the sampling switch, so the normalization never affects any exchange-rate request.
The class-level record of per-function preview windows is consulted only by the class's unreachable window resolver, so the mapping never shapes a digital-currency request.
The window resolver selects the configured preview window for a digital-currency function; its only caller sits behind the sampling switch, so the resolution never occurs.

checks.description: A module or class level switch is declared with a falsy literal and no assignment anywhere in the repository can enable it.
checks.detected_relation: staging switch declaration -> permanently falsy literal
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The switch declaration is the root cause of the unreachable cluster: every guarded branch and every helper that exists to serve the staged feature inherits its permanent False.

matches.evidence: The entitlement preflight switch is declared False at its only assignment, and no store anywhere in the package can set it, so the preflight stage is shut for every supported configuration.
The preview sampling switch is declared False at its only assignment, and no store anywhere in the package can set it, so the sampled response regime can never engage.

excluded.reason: Pre-existing unreferenced class constant; not part of the staged pipeline the case models, and flagging unreferenced base constants would fire on the clean checkout.

excluded.candidate: alpha_vantage/alphavantage.py and async mirror _output_format_sector without the sector endpoint modules
excluded.reason: Its only consumers live in the sector endpoint modules, which this fork's install contract regenerates; treating configuration-dependent decorators as dead would make the verdict depend on which files the environment restored, so the rule treats decorated members as reachable.
The sentinel is assigned from an import probe rather than a falsy literal, so it is configuration-reachable rather than permanently disabled; outside the rule.
